summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco International Growth Focus ETF (MTRA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in growth stocks using a bottom-up analysis. The fund invests in equities of any market capitalization from around the world outside the US. MTRA was launched on Jun 11, 2025 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: MTRA is an equity ETF with a total of 57 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 11.10%, ASML Holding at 7.44%, Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 4.29%, SK hynix at 3.58%, and Sartorius Stedim Biotech at 2.97%.
